bootstrap.method: participant-level bootstrap of paired differences, percentile interval

energy_pj.source: Horowitz, ISSCC 2014, 45 nm; arithmetic only, no memory traffic; order of magnitude

note: Exploratory: planned after the main study's test results were known. Bit widths below 8 are simulated (integer grids in floating point); no low-bit kernel was timed. The precision rule is read from session-1 sensitivity only; session 2 is reported to show whether it carries over.
